name: Linde LVA - Truck Unloading
summary:
This training introduces the safe and reliable unloading of liquid medical and industrial gases from a delivery truck into a customer storage tank. The process involves several safety-critical steps that must be followed carefully to protect personnel, equipment and product quality.
